pi.label: Set Sedes thread state
pi.name: sedes_thread_set_state
pi.promptSnippet: Park, snooze, or activate a Sedes thread. Parking your own thread from its current turn keeps it parked on success and returns it to Active on failure or interruption.

description: Parks, unparks, snoozes, or wakes one Sedes thread. Omit threadId to target the calling thread or the Tool client's configured default. Parking mutes progress speech. If the thread has a turn in progress, it returns to Active when that turn ends. If an agent parks its own thread from that same turn, success keeps it parked and failure or interruption returns it to Active. New approval or input requests, including nonblocking questions, wake parked and snoozed threads even after an agent self-park. Parking keeps Tasks and stashes attached. Set a parked thread to active before snoozing it. A thread already in the requested lifecycle keeps its current settings. Use thread.restore for archived threads.

lifecycle.description: Set active to unpark or wake a thread.

reminder.description: Optional wake reminder. Valid only for snoozed.

threadId.description: Defaults to the calling thread or the Tool client's configured default thread.

until.description: Future ISO timestamp with a time zone. Required only for snoozed.

lifecycle.description: Set active to unpark or wake a thread.

snoozedUntil.description: ISO timestamp of the wake deadline, present when snoozed.

wakeReminder.description: Reminder text, or null when snoozed without a reminder.
